name: Kyle
profile:
Innate Trait: Blessed with divine protection, he became
a healing mage. Finding the life of a priest unsuitable 
for him, he chose the path of an adventurer.

name: Luna
profile:
A mage of the Elven race known as <Lunatic>. He usually
runs a magical artifact shop with his mother. He set
out on a journey to save his mother, who is suffering
from an incurable illness.

name: Lillian
profile:
An elf knight known as a "Cavalier." He was once a
member of the Knights’ Order but took a leave of
absence and set out on a journey with Luna. He is large
and very strong.

name: Millet
profile:
A knight who had collapsed at the base of a cliff. He
was seriously injured, but Kyle’s healing spell saved 
his life. He is a member of the Long-Eared Tribe and is 
tall.

name: Rosé
profile:
After seeing a certain martial artist, he was inspired
by the way he fought using only his fists and feet, so
he became his disciple. After undergoing rigorous training, 
he became the martial artist known as <Fang>.
